title: Almond Blossom
short_description: Van Gogh painted these flowering branches to celebrate the birth of his nephew. White blossoms open against a clear blue sky.
bloom_note_zh:
为了迎接一个小生命，
他把春天先画好了。

title: The Starry Night
short_description: Painted in Saint-Rémy, this night sky turns stars and clouds into flowing rhythms above a quiet village.
bloom_note_zh:
村子已经睡了，天空还没睡。
有些心事，也舍不得关灯。

title: Sunflowers
label_caption: Painted in Arles, these sunflowers celebrate the many shades of yellow.
short_description: In Arles, Van Gogh made sunflower paintings to decorate the Yellow House. Warm yellows give a simple vase an extraordinary presence.
bloom_note_zh:
朋友还没到，欢迎已经画好了。
大师等人，也要先布置屋子。

title: Woman with a Parasol
short_description: Monet painted his wife Camille and their son outdoors. A breeze moves through the grass, her dress and the summer light.
bloom_note_zh:
风把裙角吹乱，家人就在身旁。
这样的出门，不必走很远。

title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
short_description: This is a tronie, a study of a character rather than a commissioned portrait. A turn of the head catches the light.
bloom_note_zh:
她只是回了个头。
我们却记住了好几百年。

title: The Kiss
label_caption: Painted during Klimt’s Golden Period, an embrace glows within a patterned cloak.
short_description: Made during Klimt’s Golden Period, two figures embrace within a patterned golden cloak at the edge of a field of flowers.
bloom_note_zh:
周围再热闹，先抱一会儿。
有些话，可以晚一点再说。

title: Café Terrace at Night
short_description: Van Gogh painted a café in Arles beneath a star-filled sky. Yellow lamplight brings warmth to the deep blue evening.
bloom_note_zh:
夜已经很深，还有桌子亮着。
总有一处，容得下晚归的人。

title: Irises
short_description: Painted in the garden at Saint-Rémy, these irises bring curling leaves and vivid flowers close to the viewer.
bloom_note_zh:
花都挤在一起，还各有各的样子。
不用一样，也能很好看。

title: Water Lilies, Evening Effect
short_description: Monet returned again and again to the pond in his garden at Giverny. Water and reflected light become the subject.
bloom_note_zh:
他总画同一个池塘。
喜欢的东西，原来不用急着换。

title: Impression, Sunrise
short_description: Monet painted the harbour of Le Havre at dawn. The title of this painting helped give Impressionism its name.
bloom_note_zh:
太阳只露出一点，早晨就来了。
重新开始，有时也不必很盛大。

title: Starry Night Over the Rhône
short_description: Gaslights reflect across the Rhône in Arles. Two small figures share the riverbank beneath the stars.
bloom_note_zh:
星星很多，河边只有两个人。
有人一起看，就不只是夜景了。

title: Haystacks, End of Summer
short_description: Monet painted the same grainstacks under changing light and seasons. Here, familiar forms hold the warmth of late summer.
bloom_note_zh:
还是那堆草，光却每天不同。
熟悉的日子，也值得再看一眼。

title: Bedroom in Arles
short_description: Van Gogh pictured his bedroom in the Yellow House in Arles. Flat colours and everyday furniture were intended to suggest rest.
bloom_note_zh:
床、椅子，还有自己的小房间。
不用多大的地方，也能安顿下来。

title: Luncheon of the Boating Party
short_description: Friends gather on a restaurant terrace beside the Seine. Renoir brings conversation, sunlight and still life into one lively scene.
bloom_note_zh:
一桌人，各聊各的。
最舍不得散的饭局，往往这样。

title: A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte
short_description: Seurat built this riverside Sunday from carefully placed touches of colour. At a distance, the small marks become a luminous whole.
bloom_note_zh:
大家都在河边，没有谁赶时间。
周日，原来早就这样过了。

title: Dance at Le Moulin de la Galette
short_description: An open-air dance in Montmartre becomes a study of shared pleasure. Sunlight falls through the trees onto a crowd of friends.
bloom_note_zh:
人很多，舞步也不必完全整齐。
高兴起来，谁还顾得上。

title: The Milkmaid
short_description: A woman pours milk beside a window. Vermeer gives an ordinary kitchen task the stillness and dignity of a carefully observed moment.
bloom_note_zh:
连倒牛奶，都被认真看了一眼。
小事有人在意，也会不一样。

title: Mona Lisa
short_description: Leonardo’s portrait is usually identified as Lisa Gherardini. Soft transitions of light connect her quiet expression with the landscape beyond.
bloom_note_zh:
她没把心思全说出来。
我们却一直想再看一眼。

title: Lady with an Ermine
short_description: Usually identified as Cecilia Gallerani, the sitter turns towards something outside the picture. The ermine echoes her poised movement.
bloom_note_zh:
她和小动物，同时转过头。
有些默契，不用先商量。

title: Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I
short_description: Klimt surrounds Adele Bloch-Bauer with gold and intricate ornament. Her face and hands emerge from a shimmering field of pattern.
bloom_note_zh:
周围都是金色，脸却最让人记住。
再多装饰，也比不过你本人。

title: Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer
short_description: Elisabeth Lederer stands in a pale dress against a richly patterned background. Klimt balances a formal portrait with decorative colour.
bloom_note_zh:
花纹那么热闹，她站得很安静。
不必抢着说话，也能被看见。

title: Whistlejacket
short_description: Stubbs presents a racehorse almost at life size against an empty background. Nothing distracts from its movement and presence.
bloom_note_zh:
背景什么也没有，它就够了。
有时，喜欢不需要太多陪衬。

title: The Hay Wain
short_description: A wagon crosses shallow water near Flatford Mill. Constable made the familiar countryside of his childhood the centre of the painting.
bloom_note_zh:
画家把熟悉的乡间画了下来。
走得再远，总有一处认得路。

title: Mont Sainte-Victoire
short_description: Cézanne returned repeatedly to this mountain near Aix-en-Provence. Patches of colour build a landscape that feels both solid and alive.
bloom_note_zh:
他一次次回来，画同一座山。
有些地方，看不腻就是答案。

title: Paris Street; Rainy Day
short_description: Umbrellas pass through a newly rebuilt Parisian street. Caillebotte gives the city’s broad avenues the intimacy of an everyday walk.
bloom_note_zh:
雨里各自撑着伞，擦肩而过。
也许你我，也曾这样路过谁。

title: The Great Wave off Kanagawa
label_caption: A towering wave frames Mount Fuji in Hokusai’s celebrated series.
short_description: This woodblock print belongs to Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji. A towering wave frames the distant mountain above three small boats.
bloom_note_zh:
浪头很大，小船很小。
有些日子，我们也这样出门。

title: Flaming June
short_description: A sleeping figure curls within a square canvas. The orange fabric and distant sea turn repose into a carefully arranged play of colour.
bloom_note_zh:
连衣裙都很忙，她却睡得很香。
今天先不叫醒她。

title: The Laughing Cavalier
short_description: The sitter’s identity is unknown. An embroidered costume and a lively expression make this portrait feel unusually immediate.
bloom_note_zh:
名字没留下，笑意却留下了。
让人记住，有时不必自我介绍。

title: Arrangement in Grey and Black No. 1
short_description: Whistler painted his mother in a restrained interior. The original title stresses the harmony of grey and black rather than a story.
bloom_note_zh:
他画的是母亲，题目却很克制。
在意的人，未必总挂在嘴边。

title: The Arnolfini Portrait
short_description: Two figures stand in a detailed domestic interior. A small convex mirror opens another view of the room and its visitors.
bloom_note_zh:
小小的镜子，藏着更多人。
有些陪伴，要再看一眼才发现。

title: Wanderer above the Sea of Fog
short_description: Seen from behind, a lone figure pauses above a mist-filled landscape. The view leaves room for the viewer’s own thoughts.
bloom_note_zh:
他站在山上，也看不清前路。
到了高处，原来也会犹豫。

title: The Hunters in the Snow
short_description: Hunters return to a snow-covered village while skaters gather below. This winter scene belongs to a series about the seasons.
bloom_note_zh:
有人往家走，有人在冰上玩。
同一个冬天，各有各的忙。

title: The Gleaners
short_description: Three women collect grain left after the harvest. Millet gives their patient labour a monumental place within the landscape.
bloom_note_zh:
她们弯下腰，把遗落的拾起来。
不起眼的，也有人认真珍惜。

title: The Art of Painting
short_description: A painter works before a model in a carefully staged room. A curtain, a map and a tiled floor invite us into his art.
bloom_note_zh:
帘子拉开，他还在慢慢画。
那些看不见的功夫，也算数。

title: A Bar at the Folies-Bergère
short_description: A barmaid stands before a mirror in a Parisian music hall. Reflections turn a seemingly direct encounter into a spatial puzzle.
bloom_note_zh:
周围这么热闹，她却安静站着。
忙完这一阵，也该歇一歇了。

title: Madame X
short_description: Sargent painted Virginie Gautreau in a striking black dress. The carefully turned profile makes the portrait a study of silhouette and poise.
bloom_note_zh:
她转过头，没急着迎合谁。
有自己的样子，就很动人。

title: The School of Athens
short_description: Raphael gathered ancient philosophers beneath monumental classical architecture. Plato and Aristotle meet at the centre of this imagined conversation.
bloom_note_zh:
大问题在谈，小话也没停。
再聪明的人，也需要聊一聊。

title: Rouen Cathedral, Full Sunlight
short_description: Monet painted the cathedral façade at different times of day. Stone becomes a surface for observing changes in sunlight and colour.
bloom_note_zh:
还是那面墙，阳光一来就不同。
有些变化，不必换一个地方。

title: The Cardsharps
short_description: A card game conceals a small deception. Caravaggio makes glances, hands and fabric tell the story before any words are spoken.
bloom_note_zh:
他认真看牌，我们看见了小动作。
有时，旁观的人先忍住笑。

title: The Stone Breakers
short_description: Courbet painted two road workers with an unsentimental attention to labour. The original was destroyed in 1945; this image preserves its appearance.
bloom_note_zh:
画里的人没抬头。
画家却认真看见了他们。

title: The Night Watch
short_description: Rembrandt turned a militia group portrait into a scene of movement. Light draws the eye through a crowd preparing to set out.
bloom_note_zh:
这么多人，谁也没老实站着。
热闹的合影，从来不好安排。

title: Las Meninas
short_description: A royal child, attendants and the painter share a room. A mirror and an outward glance make the viewer part of the scene.
bloom_note_zh:
你看这幅画，他们也在看你。
被认真看一眼，有时就很好。

title: American Gothic
short_description: Wood paired two figures with a house whose pointed window caught his attention. Their still poses echo the building’s sharply ordered shapes.
bloom_note_zh:
都站得很认真，谁也没先笑。
你有没有这样一张合影？

title: Self-Portrait with Bandaged Ear
short_description: Painted after his injury in Arles, this self-portrait shows Van Gogh at work again. A Japanese print hangs on the wall behind him.
bloom_note_zh:
不太好的日子，他又拿起画笔。
重新开始，可以先做熟悉的小事。

title: The Ambassadors
short_description: Two sitters stand among instruments of learning. The stretched shape below becomes a skull when seen from a particular angle.
bloom_note_zh:
换个位置，才看见错过的细节。
理解一个人，也常需要这一步。

title: Wheatfield with Crows
short_description: Dark birds cross a wide wheatfield under a dramatic sky. It is not securely established as Van Gogh’s final painting.
bloom_note_zh:
路往几处延伸，没有写好终点。
还没选好，也可以先走一段。

title: The Lady of Shalott
short_description: Inspired by Tennyson’s poem, a woman leaves in a boat after breaking her isolation. Autumn light gives the scene its suspended atmosphere.
bloom_note_zh:
船刚离岸，衣角还像在犹豫。
出发的人，也可以有点害怕。

title: Landscape with the Fall of Icarus
short_description: A farmer works as a ship passes along the coast. The tiny fall of Icarus is easy to miss; the painting’s attribution remains debated.
bloom_note_zh:
大场面里，也有快被忽略的小事。
愿我们还肯多看一眼。

title: The Potato Eaters
short_description: A family shares a simple meal beneath a lamp. Van Gogh wanted the hands and faces to express the realities of rural working life.
bloom_note_zh:
饭很简单，大家却围在一起。
有时候，回家就是为了这一口。

title: Barge Haulers on the Volga
short_description: Men pull a barge along the riverbank. Repin gives each worker an individual presence within a demanding shared task.
bloom_note_zh:
走得慢，是因为肩上有重量。
看懂这一点，就不急着催谁了。
